vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1656 — skip .deft-scratch in content standards scans

plan.title: Content-standards tests must skip .deft-scratch swarm worktrees

narratives.Description: Content-standards markdown scanners walk the repo via `allMdFiles()` but `SKIP_DIRS` omits `.deft-scratch`. Leftover swarm worktrees under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/` get scanned as framework docs, causing false failures in `task check` and blocking release CI.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add `.deft-scratch` to `SKIP_DIRS` in `packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/_helpers.ts` so `allMdFiles()` skips swarm worktree trees.
2. Add regression test in `packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/standards.test.ts` (or dedicated helper test) asserting markdown under `.deft-scratch/` is excluded.
3. Run `pnpm -w exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/standards.test.ts` as verification evidence; CHANGELOG entry. Closes #1656.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running swarms or local release cuts, I want stale worktrees ignored by content-standards scans, so that `task check` does not fail on unrelated files in `.deft-scratch/`.
narratives.Overview: See issue #1656 — v0.48.0 release blocked by 60 failures from stale `.deft-scratch/worktrees/` paths.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a markdown file exists only under `.deft-scratch/worktrees/test/`, when `allMdFiles()` runs, then that path is not included in the scan set.
Given a unit test creates a violating markdown file under `.deft-scratch/`, when content-standards tests run, then no failure is reported for that path.
Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, then it documents `.deft-scratch` exclusion from content-standards scans. Closes #1656.
